### The Great Gift of Gratitude
Author: Beloved Women
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/beloved-women/beloved-women-december-29-2020.html
Passage: Hebrews 12:28
Points:
- Unstable circumstances cannot shake God’s eternal kingdom.
- Hardship should lead believers to revere God’s sovereignty rather than question His motives.
- Gratitude brings delight to God’s heart as we praise Him.
- Thankfulness anchors the believer's heart and opens the eyes to further grace.
- Believers remain securely held by an unshakable God.

### An Unshakable Kingdom
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/unshakable-kingdom
Passage: Hebrews 12:28-29
Points:
- Believers belong to the superior new covenant and have received an unshakable kingdom.
- When Christ returns to shake heaven and earth, only His kingdom will endure.
- The proper response to receiving this eternal kingdom is deep gratitude.
- Ingratitude frequently serves as the first step toward drifting from God.
- True worship is marked by reverence and awe toward God as a consuming fire.
